# T-1: Add pass history parameter to prompt builder

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Extend the guardrail evaluation prompt builder to accept a list of previously-passed guardrail IDs and inject a 'Previously Passed Guardrails' section into the prompt when the list is non-empty.

## Acceptance Criteria
- buildGuardrailPromptFromFiltered accepts an optional previouslyPassed parameter
- When previouslyPassed is non-empty, prompt contains a 'Previously Passed Guardrails' section with the IDs
- When previouslyPassed is empty or undefined, prompt is identical to current behavior

## Implementation Notes
Add a previouslyPassed parameter to buildGuardrailPromptFromFiltered. When non-empty, append a section after the Rules block instructing the AI to consider these guardrails as previously passed. Thread the parameter through checkGuardrail.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for buildGuardrailPromptFromFiltered with and without previouslyPassed. Verify prompt content contains/omits the section.
